description: Startup self-test plan consumed by the self-test command. Each check names a tool resolved by the toolkit, the version arguments to run, and what a failure means. Status vocabulary: FOUND, MISSING, WRONG VERSION, BROKEN, LICENSE REQUIRED, DEVICE REQUIRED, NETWORK REQUIRED, HOST FEATURE REQUIRED.

checks.meaning: Core lane parser runtime. Every pure-Python command depends on it.
Required by apktool, apksigner and bundletool. Java 17 is the catalog baseline; 11 works for the tested tool versions.
Optional cross-check for the built-in manifest parser.
Used by apktool when building with AAPT2 resources.
Signing and verification lane. Approval is required before signing.
Page alignment stage of the rebuild pipeline. zipalign -P needs build-tools 35+; older releases only support -f 4 and -p.
Decode/rebuild lane. Set APKTOOL_JAR or --apktool-jar to a versioned JAR.
Device lane. Reports DEVICE REQUIRED when no authorized device is attached.
Hardware acceleration for emulators. Reports HOST FEATURE REQUIRED when /dev/kvm is absent.
